dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what do you do now?

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call it a "job," it's more like work I found to feed myself. As an old-timer who's lived here so long, I provide guidance to the newcomers who have just arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: But once you've settled into life here, you're unlikely to run into any real trouble. After all, whether you are wealthy or poor, it makes no difference here.
